title: The coefficient extension integers have a finite Z_l basis
statement:
The integral coefficient ring O_E of [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings], with its specified Z_l action, admits a basis indexed by Fin k for some finite k.

theorem purTwistIntegralBasis (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∃ k : ℕ, Nonempty (@Module.Basis (Fin k) ℤ_[l]
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) _ _
        (Module.compHom (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (purTwistIntegersMap l E)))

source.place: Coefficient-twist blueprint proof step 5; Stacks Tags 00NZ and 0AUW.

proof.text: Identify O_E with the integral closure of Z_l by the spectral-value criterion for the monic minimal polynomial and integral closedness of the valuation ring. Apply IsIntegralClosure.module_free and finite generation, then reindex its finite basis by Fin k. This is the complete integral_basis proof already present privately in PurTwistCoefficientTensor, now available independently.
